title: Apple MacBook Air M2 - 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD
description: MacBook Air M2 chip with 8-core CPU, 8-core GPU, 8GB unified memory, 256GB SSD, 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display, backlit Magic Keyboard, all-day battery life up to 18 hours.

reviews.author: Amit R.
reviews.title: Best laptop for productivity
reviews.body: M2 chip is a beast for everyday tasks. Battery easily lasts a full work day. Fanless design is silent.

reviews.author: Sneha M.
reviews.title: Premium build quality
reviews.body: Thin and light design. Retina display is colour-accurate. macOS ecosystem is seamless.

reviews.author: Vikram J.
reviews.title: Pricey but worth it
reviews.body: Performance is excellent. Would like more ports and slightly brighter display outdoors.
